jobs.description:
Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. Through this work, they make a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of significant growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer. 

In this role, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative environment within a leading global pharmaceutical company.

As a Warehouse & Operations Associate, your responsibilities will primarily focus on operational warehouse activities with an accurate administrative follow-up. 
	
• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.	
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.	
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.	
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.	
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.	
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities.

	
• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.	
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.	
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.	
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.	
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.	
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

We connect the brightest minds in Europe to make industry greener, smarter and truly sustainable.

Jobomschrijving

Primary responsibilities project management support (50%):
	
• Creating timelines and contributing to effective planning of funded project activities.	
• Monitoring budgets of EU-funded projects and tracking team members’ time dedication consistently, systematically, and coherently.	
• Supporting team members in completing tasks, drafting, and submitting reports.	
• Oversee and implement the communication and dissemination tasks of projects.	
• Support organising conferences, events, meetings, and other activities linked to projects.	
• Providing communication support to Processes4Planet projects.

Communications activities and providing value to members (50%)
	
• Create a yearly Communication Plan and track its implementation,	
• Manage and enhance the Association’s external communication channels (website, social media, newsletters, etc.), 	
• Operate members-only collaboration tools (e.g. SharePoint),	
• Manage internal communication with company members by operating the existing tools or suggesting new ideas.	
• Generate and write content for social media, news releases, newsletters, bulletins, etc.	
• Prepare presentations and small publications and manage relations with providers.	
• Support to facilitate networking activities 	
• Organise participation in external conferences, and support with organization of internal events (conferences, workshops, webinars, etc.).

Qualifications and experience:
	
• Degree in project management, communications, public relations, business administration or related studies.	
• Minimum 3 years of experience in positions dealing with the tasks described for this position, with excellent performance.	
• Experience with EU funds is an asset.

Your key skills:
	
• An energetic person with a hands-on approach, task-oriented with attention to detail	
• Team player with a cooperative spirit	
• Ability to work in a small core team and diverse virtual teams with people across organizational boundaries and several countries/regions.	
• Outstanding organisation and prioritization skills with a capacity to retro plan and fulfil strict deadlines.	
• High-quality results and output oriented.	
• Capacity to work with complexity and to juggle a variety of tasks flexibly and proactively.	
• Creative problem-solving skills, able to anticipate needs and deliver your work autonomously
Technical skills and languages:
	
• Strong skills in Word, PowerPoint, Excel and collaborative online tools (e.g. SharePoint).	
• Experience in project management.	
• Excellent spoken and written English. Other languages are an asset.

As a Project Manager you are in charge of the organisation, coordination of assessments for members of the association in many different countries in Europe. 

Client Details

European association located in Brussels

Description

• You coordinate and ensure the smooth delivery of the assessments, online or face-to-face 
• You liaise with candidates, suppliers, volunteers, committee members, speakers, examiners and hosts
• You work closely with the subcommittee, attending their meetings, taking minutes and ensuring the implementation of their decisions and policies.
• You work closely with the Registration, IT, Finance, Education and Communication departments.
• You carry out various organisational and administrative tasks such as maintaining examination data, drafting reports, updating procedures and policies, and promoting courses and examinations.

• You hold a bachelor's degree or higher qualification and have at least three years' relevant experience in project, administration, event, examination or programme coordination
• English excellent level
• You have a special interest in education and training.
• You are a methodical and meticulous organiser who maintains high standards and pays close attention to detail.
• You show a diplomatic attitude, making it easy for you to interact and communicate in a mature and professional manner within and outside the organisation.
• You are willing to travel by plane (7-8 times a year).
• You are willing to deliver activities scheduled on weekends (9-10 weekends a year).

In this role, you will be responsible for managing customer orders from A to Z, ensuring an excellent customer experience, and acting as the key point of contact between customers and internal departments. You will work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Production teams to guarantee smooth order processing and timely deliveries.

Client Details

Our client, an international company operating in the manufacturing sector, is looking for a Customer Service Representative to join its customer-facing team.

Description

In this role, you will be responsible for managing customer orders from A to Z, ensuring an excellent customer experience, and acting as the key point of contact between customers and internal departments. You will work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Production teams to guarantee smooth order processing and timely deliveries.

 

Key Responsibilities

• Manage customer orders throughout the entire order-to-cash process.
• Enter and follow up on orders in the ERP system.
• Serve as the primary contact for customer enquiries regarding orders, deliveries, and product availability.
• Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient order fulfillment.
• Monitor delivery schedules and proactively communicate any changes or delays.
• Resolve customer issues and identify appropriate solutions.
• Maintain accurate customer records and administrative documentation.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives related to customer service processes.
• Build and maintain strong long-term customer relationships.
 

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Previous experience in Customer Service, Order Management, Sales Support, or a similar administrative position.
• Strong communication skills and customer-oriented mindset.
• Fluent in Dutch and English. French is considered an asset.
• Experience working with ERP systems (SAP knowledge is a plus).
• Good command of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

Personal Skills

• Proactive and solution-oriented.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Team player with a collaborative mindset.
• Resilient and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Customer-focused with excellent relationship-building skills.

The company is the European division of the American company. The company is the largest supplier of products in the industry chemicals. The European Headquarter is in Brussels.

The company  is a strong medium sized company, large enough to be the market leader, but small enough to continue to cultivate our “family" spirit and a friendly, cooperative spirit between colleagues across multiple countries.

Since 2022, we are recognized as a Happy@Work company both in Europe and in Belgium. 

Jobomschrijving

Your mission:

•   Office management: visitors' reception, expense reports, mail handling, management of the office supplies, management of the meeting rooms, organization of meetings and trade shows, invoices…
•   Sales & Customer service support: 
o    General customer service support during peak season 
o    Take off work from customer service representatives to allow them to take care of most of the order management of regular and recurring unit orders
o    Assist the sales team with any support work such as: calling customers monthly to check their needs with them for the rolling forecast, proactively following up in writing on smaller quotes (during peak season from March to July)
o    Marketing support during trade shows
o    Organize sales trips/shows for Area Managers (logistics and visit appointments, hotels, flights, car rentals)
o    Follow up with Area Managers to make sure action item deadlines are observed
o    Handle market surveys by phone and analyze the answers and report the conclusion and /or recommendations
o    Communicate with sales team about validated prospects and their needs
o    Support the sales team with collection calls

Your profile:
•    You have 2-3 years experience in a similar role
•    You can communicate easily in French, English and Dutch, oral and written. Any additional European language is a plus
•    You have a very good knowledge of Outlook, Word and Excel
Your competencies:
•    You are customer oriented
•    You have administrative, record-keeping, and clerical skills;
•    You can work in a fast and demanding environment in a multitasking mode
•    You have strong interpersonal skills;
•    You can manage priorities and you have an eye for details
•    You are a problem-solver 
•    You are organized and rigorous

Our distinguished firm, with a team of 900 advisors across the Benelux, Switzerland, and global financial centers, serves as the preferred legal and tax partner for businesses in the Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg, and Switzerland.

Clients benefit from personalized counsel, leveraging our full-service approach, sector-specific expertise, and extensive market knowledge.

can you recognise yourself in this?

Our client is a leading industrial manufacturing organisation operating within a highly technical and project-driven production environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Assess the manufacturability and technical feasibility of customer-approved designs, identifying risks, constraints, and optimisation opportunities.
• Create and maintain production documentation including technical drawings, CAD models, work instructions, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and ERP master data.
• Provide technical support to production teams, troubleshoot manufacturing issues, and contribute to root cause analyses and corrective actions.
• Optimise designs, materials, and production processes to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance manufacturing performance.
• Collaborate closely with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Product Management, and Engineering teams to ensure technical alignment and operational excellence.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Engineering, Design Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, technical design, or a similar production-focused role.
• Strong proficiency with CAD software (such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Inventor) and experience managing BOMs, routings, and technical master data in ERP systems (SAP, Dynamics, or similar).
• Solid understanding of manufacturing processes, design for manufacturability principles, technical problem solving, and cost estimation within an industrial environment.
• Analytical, detail-oriented, and hands-on professional with strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple departments.
• Fluent in English and Dutch

• Analyse customer feedback and data to identify areas for improvement.
• Ensure compliance with company policies and industry standards.
• Collaborate with other departments to align customer service goals with overall business objectives.

• At least 5 years of leadership experience in Customer Service, Supply Chain, Commercial Operations or Business Management
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English 
• Experience in exposure to executive leadership and cross-functional decision-making

• Strong background in change management and organizational transformation

• Minimum 10 years' experience in procurement within an industrial environment

• Experience negotiating contracts and driving savings initiatives
• Familiarity with ERP systems and advanced Excel skills
• Fluent in English, Dutch and French

• Results-driven, organised and resilient mindset

They are urgently looking for a Customer Service & Sales Support Coordinator.

Your proactive approach helps guarantee an excellent customer experience from order placement through delivery and invoicing.

• Handle customer complaints and act as liaison between customers and internal departments to resolve issues effectively and implement corrective actions.

•

jobs.occupation: Bus Mechanic – good salary + training opportunies
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working on vehicles and solving technical problems? In this role as a bus mechanic, you ensure that coaches are safe, reliable and ready for daily operations.

• You carry out maintenance and repairs on buses.

• You diagnose mechanical issues and fix them efficiently.

• You perform preventive maintenance to keep vehicles in top condition.

• You work on a varied fleet of different brands and models.

• You ensure every vehicle meets safety and quality standards.

• You have a background in mechanics (experience is a strong plus).

• You can work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.

• You are able to identify and solve technical problems.

• You are eager to learn and interested in new vehicle technologies (like electricity).

• You are open to following additional training.

• You speak Dutch or English.

• You are flexible with working hours while valuing a good work-life balance.

• A driving license D is a plus.
